entities.name: Jan Šindel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jan Šindel, also known as Jan Ondřejův, was a Czech medieval scientist and Catholic priest. He was a professor at Charles University in Prague and became the rector of the university in 1410. He lectured on mathematics and astronomy and was also a personal astrologer and physician of kings Wenceslaus IV of Bohemia and his brother Holy Roman Emperor Sigismund.
